About this place

Teams working at Nateshwar have documented multiple layers of occupation. Excavated structures include substantial brick monuments and features interpreted as stupas. An announced relic-chamber discovery adds evidence for Buddhist ritual activity. Published dates apply to particular layers and finds, so the complex is best understood as a site that changed over time.

Check site access locally and stay on permitted paths. Excavation and conservation work can change what is open.
